fact: TechHive Advisory reviews a draft Artificial Intelligence law introduced in Angola, a comprehensive framework for the development, supply and use of AI with a risk-based approach and extraterritorial reach; the document gives no date for the draft, so its published date of 2025-12-29 is used.
source_slug: 2025-12-29 Review of Angola's Proposed Law on Artificial Intelligence

fact: The MINTTICS public consultation portal lists the Proposta de Lei Sobre a Inteligencia Artificial as a document under consultation and records 18 contributions from companies, 18 from specialists and 5 from the general public; the portal is undated, so the capture date of 2026-08-27 is used.
